children: By Staff Writer

As South Africa's e-commerce sector continues to grow, customer expectations have fundamentally changed too. Real-time parcel tracking, proactive delivery notifications and frictionless online shopping experiences are no longer reserved for global retailers, they are increasingly expected by consumers buying from businesses of every size.

For many South African SMEs, however, meeting those expectations often comes at the expense of valuable time spent manually generating quotes, creating shipments, responding to delivery queries and updating customers. Increasingly, logistics is becoming as much an administrative challenge as an operational one.
Fastway Couriers believes that needs to change.

To help businesses simplify the shipping process, the company has launched its new self-service customer platform, designed to automate up to 85% of delivery processes while giving businesses complete visibility and control from quote through to proof of delivery.

Early adoption has already delivered measurable results, with businesses using the platform processing shipments up to 70% faster. More than 7 million shipments have already been created through the platform, demonstrating the growing demand among South African businesses for simpler, more automated delivery management.

Built on secure RESTful API architecture, the platform connects directly with customers' existing business systems, allowing information to move seamlessly between sales, dispatch and delivery. The result is a connected logistics ecosystem that reduces administration, improves visibility and makes it easier for businesses to grow without increasing operational complexity.

"Automation and API connectivity aren't simply about making deliveries faster," says Danie Taljaard, IT director at Fastway Couriers. "They're about giving businesses greater control, reducing unnecessary administration and allowing logistics to happen in the background so owners can focus on serving customers and growing their business."

Unlike traditional courier processes that often require multiple touchpoints, manual updates and customer follow-ups, the self-service platform allows businesses to manage every stage of the delivery journey from a single intuitive interface.
Key features include:
- Instant quoting and shipment creation via API or online dashboard.
- Automated label generation.
- Real-time parcel tracking.
- Branded customer notifications via WhatsApp, SMS and email.
- Seamless integration with existing business systems, eliminating duplicate data capture and reducing manual errors.

Rather than misspending valuable time, businesses can automate repetitive tasks while reducing many of the hidden costs associated with logistics administration - from duplicated data capture and shipment errors to unnecessary customer support queries.

"For many SMEs, logistics has become a significant drain on time and productivity. Every hour spent generating quotes, creating shipments or responding to routine tracking queries is time that could be spent serving customers and growing the business," continues Taljaard.

"By bringing the entire delivery process into one connected platform, we're removing unnecessary administration and giving businesses greater control and visibility. The result is less time spent managing logistics, fewer avoidable errors, and more time focused on winning customers, growing revenue, and scaling with confidence. That's what 'One less thing to worry about' looks like in practice."
The customer-facing platform forms part of Fastway's broader investment in automation across its network, using technology to remove repetitive processes for both customers and operational teams.

Behind the scenes, Fastway has also transformed operations at its Johannesburg hub - one of South Africa's most advanced courier facilities - where smart sorting technology can process more than 6 000 parcels an hour, improving productivity by up to 85% while accelerating turnaround times.

Importantly, Taljaard stresses that automation isn't replacing people, it's allowing them to focus where they add the greatest value. "Technology should enhance the customer experience, not replace it. Customers don't judge a retailer by their website alone anymore, they judge them by the delivery experience too. That's why logistics has become a competitive advantage rather than simply an operational function."

"By automating repetitive processes, our franchisees and support teams can spend more time solving problems, supporting customers and delivering the personal service that has always been central to the Fastway business."

Supported by more than 800 franchisee-owned operations across 16 regions, Fastway combines national reach with local owner-operator accountability, ensuring every parcel receives the care and attention that comes from people who have a genuine stake in every delivery.

Customers using the platform also benefit from real-time delivery visibility, geo-tagged proof of delivery, automated notifications and optional extended liability cover of up to R30,000 per parcel, giving businesses complete transparency throughout the delivery journey.
Additional Fastway platform metrics:
- 100% of all bookings are now completed through the self-service platform, including those processed via Fastway’s legacy system.
- Overall system performance has improved with faster response times during consignment creation and a considerable reduction in processing and waiting times.
- 1 500+ API integrations completed since launch.
- 23% increase in sign-ups since moving over to the self-service platform.

As customer expectations continue to rise, Fastway believes the next competitive advantage for growing businesses will come from removing operational friction rather than adding more people, processes and administration.

By combining smart automation with responsive human service, Fastway is helping South African businesses simplify their logistics, scale more efficiently and reclaim valuable time to focus on what matters most: serving customers, winning new business and growing with confidence.
